artworkType.en: Authored educational SVG: original reference-informed head/torso artwork and attributed Servier-based support adaptations
artworkType.zh: 教学 SVG：参考资料辅助创作的头部与躯干图，以及署名的 Servier 支持结构改绘图

referencePolicy.en: No reference bitmap or traced path is embedded. Servier-inspired support compositions are attributed as adaptations under CC BY 4.0. Head/torso references are reference-only; OpenStax is fact-reference-only. See per-part derivation and attribution.
referencePolicy.zh: 未嵌入参考位图或描摹路径。受 Servier 构图启发的支持结构按 CC BY 4.0 署名改绘；头部及躯干资料为参考，OpenStax 仅用于事实核对。详见逐项改绘与署名记录。

limitations.en: This is a teaching atlas with simplified depth, representative tissue samples and alternative anatomy panels. It is not scan-registered, measurement-grade or intended for clinical procedures.
limitations.zh: 本教学图谱简化深度关系，使用代表性组织样本与不同解剖示例。并非扫描配准模型，不用于测量或临床操作。

references.title: Head lateral mouth anatomy
references.creator: Patrick J. Lynch, medical illustrator; C. Carl Jaffe, MD, cardiologist
references.use: Reference only, original pixels inspected. Adult sagittal proportions, palate, tongue, pharynx and brainstem relationships. No tracing or copied art.

references.title: Head lateral sagittal brain
references.creator: Patrick J. Lynch, medical illustrator; C. Carl Jaffe, MD, cardiologist
references.use: Reference only, original pixels inspected. Adult cranial profile and cerebellum, pons, medulla positions. Recognized as composite rather than literal all-structures midsagittal view.

references.title: Salivary glands
references.creator: Servier Medical Art
references.use: Reference only, original PNG inspected. Gland placement, lobulated shape and duct direction; no source geometry used.

references.title: Anatomy and Physiology 2e, 22.1, Figure 22.4 Upper Airway

references.use: Anatomical fact validation only. Actual figure pixels inspected. No pixels, copied geometry or prose incorporated.
